explanation: The value is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and at every D1 that shows a reward. It fires only at D1 when the previous trial chose a2 and got no reward (most often an a2 that went to S2 the common way), usually 6-10 (typically 10) from about trial 35 to 85, weaker (0-5) earlier or late in the episode, and the agent then usually switches to a1.
